Our Farm

A working strelitzia farm on the Wild Coast

Wildcoast Seeds is based at Kei Mouth on South Africa's Wild Coast, where Etienne Kruger has worked with strelitzia since 1959. The farm itself was established in 1973 and has grown into a dedicated strelitzia seed operation stretching close to 1.2 kilometres, hand tended from end to end.

Our seed is hand-picked, and not only on the farm itself. Over the years, more than 2,000 independent seed pickers along the Wild Coast, from the East London area up toward Port St Johns and at times as far afield as Mozambique, have supplied stock through Wildcoast Seeds. It is a genuine community of growers and pickers behind every shipment we send out.

Life on the farm: sunbirds and the Kei Mouth birding club are regular visitors among the flowers.

Strelitzia reginae

Reginae: the queen of our fields

Reginae, Latin for queen, is the strelitzia most people picture: bold orange petals with a deep blue crown, held above paddle-shaped leaves. It is the backbone of what we grow at Kei Mouth and makes up the bulk of the seed volume we ship each season.

  • Orange and blue flower, the classic bird of paradise silhouette
  • The variety grown in greatest volume on our farm
  • Graded on arrival: A-grade seed is shiny and jet black with no grey, B-grade is greyish with a lower expected germination rate

Reginae flowering across our fields at Kei Mouth, ready for the next pick.

Strelitzia nicolai

Nicolai: the giant white bird of paradise

Strelitzia nicolai grows as a tall, tree-like plant with white and blue flowers and the same paddle-shaped leaves as reginae, just on a much larger scale. Named after a person rather than a title, hence the "ai" ending rather than reginae's "ae", it is the second variety we grow and seed at Kei Mouth.

  • White and blue flower on a tall, tree-form plant, sometimes called the giant white bird of paradise
  • Grown and seeded alongside reginae on the same farm
  • Graded and cleaned using the same process as reginae seed

Nicolai grows alongside reginae at Kei Mouth, standing tall above the rows as a tree-form plant.

Quality

From the field to the freight hold

Every batch of Wildcoast Seeds passes through the same four stages before it leaves Kei Mouth.

01

Hand-picked

Every seed head is hand-picked by pickers from the Kei Mouth community, working the fields the same way pickers have for generations.

02

Cleaned and dried

Seed is cleaned, dried and sorted, with damaged or undersized seed removed by hand before it goes any further.

03

Inspected and certified

Every batch is inspected and issued a phytosanitary certificate ahead of export, so distributors know exactly what they are receiving.

04

Air-freighted

Finished seed is air-freighted to distributors in the United States and worldwide, fast enough to match growing seasons that sea freight cannot.

Wholesale

Bulk strelitzia seed, ready for export

Wildcoast Seeds supplies strelitzia seed at an industrial scale, shipping 15 to 20 tonnes at a time by air freight to distributors in the United States and beyond. We are also exploring smaller retail packs alongside our bulk supply for the future.

1.2km Farm length, hand-tended end to end
2,000+ Independent seed pickers over the years
15 to 20t Shipped by air freight per order
